title: Securities Act of 1933 — Statute profile
subject: Securities Act of 1933
summary: Securities Act of 1933 is a statute of United States enacted in 1933, in the area of securities. Requires registration and disclosure for public offerings of securities. It is formally cited as 48 Stat. 74.
key_points: Core effect: Requires registration and disclosure for public offerings of securities.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
